name: Apartment Move
tagline: Plan your apartment move: deadlines, movers, address changes and move-out inspection
description: Plans your apartment move from the first quote to the last change-of-address notice. You give the date, the size of your home, whether you rent or own and who is helping; the Solver builds a deadline-based schedule, helps you compare moving company quotes with the right questions, and hands you a list of who to notify about your new address plus a photo-based move-out inspection walkthrough. It is built for people moving apartments in Brazil without professional help: the address-change list (Detran, TSE, Receita Federal, Correios, utilities) and the rental notes (Brazilian tenancy law) are Brazil-specific. What it does not do: it is not legal advice (rental contracts, security deposits and penalties depend on your contract and local law; check with your landlord, the rental agency or a lawyer), it does not recommend companies or guarantee prices, it does not cover international or office moves, and it does not fill in forms for you. Deadlines and rules of agencies and utility companies change: the Solver points out what to check on each one's official website.

creator.name: Marina
creator.bio: I have moved apartments three times (two rentals, one owned) and helped friends move. The knowledge comes from my own experience, not from a professional background in the field.

steps.title: Assess your move
gate: Date (or weeks until the move) confirmed with the user
Current home situation (rented, owned or family-owned) and destination noted
Volume and who helps defined in ranges
Move summary sheet shown to and approved by the user

steps.title: Build the schedule by deadline
gate: Deadline windows with real dates calculated from the move date
Every task has an owner and a due date
3 critical tasks marked with the reason
Schedule adjusted to the profile (home, volume and help) and checked by the user

steps.title: Hire the moving company
gate: A single written quote request with date, addresses (neighborhood and city), floors and large items
At least 2 quotes compared in the same format, or a decision not to hire a registered company
Comparison shows what each quote includes and excludes, using the amounts provided by the user
Insurance, cancellation and written confirmation checked before signing

steps.title: Close the paperwork and the move-out inspection
gate: Address-change list filled in with what, who and by when, each deadline marked to check at the official source
Move-out inspection carried out with photos and meter readings, or marked not applicable (owned home)
Move-day and following-week checklists delivered to the user
Reminder to check official sources given to the user, without legal advice

sources: The creator's own experience of three apartment moves
Official websites of utility companies, banks and public agencies in Brazil (generic lookup, to be verified case by case)
